Hi Danielle / ACME Ops team,

Attached is our proposed upgrade plan for your Private (VPC) environment. High level summary first:

- Objective: Deploy runtime v4.3.1 with improved KV cache handling and a compatibility shim for your L7 ingress rules.
- Canary approach: 3 staging slices (5%, 25%, 100%) across two rack zones in your staging VPC; production will mirror after staging sign-off.
- Compatibility gates: healthcheck p95 < 200ms, error rate < 0.5% over a 10-min window, KV miss ratio < 3% after warmup.
- Abort signature: proposed authorized callers: Neha Kapoor (SRE lead), Laura Bennett (PM), Rohan Mehta (Ops owner). Anyone outside this list can request a pause but cannot abort.
- Rollback target: container image tag revert to v4.3.0 with KV cache rehydrate; target RTO under 20 minutes for service restore in most scenarios.

Attachments: upgrade-plan-staging-slices.xlsx (schedules + per-slice checklists), network-cordon-diagram.png (netops steps).

Ask: Please review the compatibility gates and abort signature. We need confirmation or suggested edits within 48 hours to keep the dry-run on Wed 2027-06-30. Also call out any procurement or KMS approvals needed for the key rotation step in section 3.

Thanks,
Rohan

Danielle / team — quick technical clarifications and the rollback checklist I've attached. TL;DR: worst-case rollback path is the full control-plane container revert + BGP quiesce undo + KV cache rehydrate. Rough timing breakdown (staging/prod similar):

- Stop new connections at load balancer and shift traffic to backup slice: 2–3 minutes.
- Pull new images and redeploy previous image across the slice: ~8–12 minutes (parallel ops across 3 pods).
- KV cache rehydrate (from snapshot + warmed KEYS): 4–6 minutes; if snapshot unavailable, cold-start may add 20–30 minutes — this is the main worst-case delta.
- Network rollback (if iptables / BGP changed): 5–8 minutes depending on netops confirmation.

Total optimistic: ~17 minutes. Worst-case (cold cache + network coordination): ~45 minutes. We call out the cold-cache path in rollback-checklist.md and include a cache-invalidation probe to detect corruption; if probe fails, the abort signature should be used and we revert to a pinned image + explicit rehydrate window.

Preflight checks to run before slice 1:
- KV snapshot integrity check (sha256)
- Canaries for JIT compilation toggles (if enabled)
- L7 ingress rules dry-apply in staging routing table

I've attached rollback-checklist.md with operator commands and the exact probes. Also note the KMS rotation step is a short-lived key change limited to the admin key; our runbook calls for rotating only the ephemeral key used during the migration window and not the customer root key. That should keep your security review light.

-- Karthik
Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
